Subject: Sprint Zero: Runway orientation + lab stress plan

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. To keep momentum on the POC, we’d like to run a short "Sprint Zero" orientation + hands-on lab the week of Nov 23. The goal: align stakeholders, review prompt/routing expectations, and run a light stress rehearsal so we have a plan for the formal load tests.

Proposed agenda (45 min):
- 5m introductions & roles (who owns success criteria)
- 10m goals & success criteria validation
- 10m prompt review: sample prompts and routing policies
- 15m lab readiness & small-scale stress run (verify KV cache, batching, infra reachability)
- 5m next steps / action items

We have three tentative 45-minute windows currently available in the attached lab-slot-grid.xlsx: Nov 24 10:00-10:45 PT, Nov 25 14:00-14:45 PT, Nov 26 09:00-09:45 PT. Can you confirm what works for your team? If none of these fit, propose 2 alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Prep items (quick):
- Please upload a representative sample prompt set (CSV) to the Drive folder we shared — we included a tiny example in prompt-sample-set.csv.
- Confirm network/SSO contact if you need on-prem firewall rules or allowlist changes.
- Tell us expected peak concurrent users / QPS for the rehearsal (ballpark is fine).

Attachments: Sprint0-Runbook-v1.pdf (draft runbook), lab-slot-grid.xlsx, prompt-sample-set.csv

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,

- If you use SAML, share ACS endpoint; if not, we’ll proceed with short-lived test tokens.
